pages.title: Kobus Kennedy
pages.description: A monograph on the name Kobus Kennedy, in volumes: the name, a broadcast from SAfm, and the presenter who read it out.

pages.title: The Name · Kobus Kennedy
pages.description: Volume I. Eight chapters on twelve letters: origins, sound, anatomy, letters, figures, the monogram, company and weight.

pages.title: The Broadcast · Kobus Kennedy
pages.description: Volume II. Forty seconds of SAfm radio, the callers who named the mystery song, the 1974 record Pick Up the Pieces, and the Miami session that made it.

pages.title: The Presenter · Kobus Kennedy
pages.description: Volume III. Rafe Lavine: thirty years of South African radio, his SAfm programmes, his ten records, and what could be checked.

pages.title: Editions · Kobus Kennedy
pages.description: How this site grows: a log of every edition, and the open questions the next one might answer.
